text: Mr. Darnel Harris has developed a Mobility Greenway idea for Finch Avenue West along the new Finch West Avenue Light Rail Transit project. Mr. Harris would like to present his idea to the Public Works and Infrastructure Committee as a deputation.

The Public Works and Infrastructure Committee: 1. Referred the item to the General Manager, Transportation Services with a request to consider the idea of a Finch West Mobility Greenway as part of the City's Complete Street Guidelines.
